guest_request_truthfulness.acknowledged: The kiosk may say the request was created/dispatched only after workflow commit.
guest_request_truthfulness.completed: Never claim completion until business state is completed.
guest_request_truthfulness.staff_confirmed_services: Never claim a reservation, price, vehicle, tour, treatment or late checkout is confirmed until staff confirmation is recorded.

room_access.room_access_note: Prototype policy forbids autonomous key entry or DND override. Any room-entry exception requires authorized staff handling and audit logging.

timing_semantics.sla_minutes: Runtime first-attendance/first-staff-response target, not a completion guarantee.
timing_semantics.expected_resolution_windows: Planning ranges only; never presented as a guaranteed completion time.
timing_semantics.peak_load: Runtime base SLA remains deterministic; simulation/evaluation may apply occupancy/daypart multipliers from metadata/property_simulation.json. These multipliers are synthetic and not official Furama staffing commitments.
